title: Killer step corollary: bipartite, no 4-cycle, AND/OR gates of fan-in two: same-colour letters lit by an operand of ANDs below F coincide, given two pairs
formal_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (s : Fin n → Bool) (t1 t2 : ℕ) (b1 b2 : Fin 2) (u1 v1 u2 v2 w1 w2 : Fin n), PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 n C → PEqualNP.TopForm.NoFourCycle G → (∀ x y : Fin n, G.Adj x y → s x ≠ s y) → t1 < C.gates.length → t2 < C.gates.length → (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C t1).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C t2).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → PEqualNP.TopForm.BelowF G C t1 → PEqualNP.TopForm.BelowF G C t2 → PEqualNP.TopForm.opnd C t1 (1 - b1) = PEqualNP.TopForm.opnd C t2 (1 - b2) → ¬ G.Adj u1 v1 → ¬ G.Adj u2 v2 → s u1 = s w1 → s u2 = s w1 → s v1 ≠ s w1 → s v2 ≠ s w1 → v1 ≠ v2 → s w2 = s w1 → PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.wireVal n C (PEqualNP.TopForm.opnd C t1 b1) (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput u1 v1) = true → PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.wireVal n C (PEqualNP.TopForm.opnd C t2 b2) (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput u2 v2) = true → PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.wireVal n C (PEqualNP.TopForm.opnd C t1 (1 - b1)) (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput w1 w1) = true → PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.wireVal n C (PEqualNP.TopForm.opnd C t1 (1 - b1)) (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput w2 w2) = true → w1 = w2
plain_statement: G a graph with no 4-cycle, two-coloured by s (adjacent vertices get different colours); F its edge function. C: AND and OR gates, each reading exactly two earlier wires. T1, T2 AND gates below F (possibly the same) with a common operand wire K. For i = 1, 2, u_i and v_i are not adjacent and T_i's other operand is true at the input with exactly u_i and v_i on; u1, u2 have w1's colour, v1, v2 the other, v1 differs from v2. If w2 has w1's colour and K is true at the inputs with only w1 on and with only w2 on, then w1 = w2.
